note: Plant tags, needs card, care icons, need dots, bloom/resting, damp soil. UI art is 2x (draw at half the PNG pixel size). Soil overlays are 1x backdrop pixels (1280x720 art space).

tag.anchorNote: bottom-centre of the stake (where it meets the ground)
tag.faceBoxNote: empty wooden face, safe area for code-drawn icons/dots/text (PNG px, x0,y0,x1,y1)
tag.scale: draw size = PNG px * plot.scale / 2  ->  back row (0.5): 56x57, front row (0.62): 69x70 display px
tag.bedsNote: backdrop px (1280x720), on the lawn just in front of each bed's front-left rim corner; draw after plants (in front of the rim). Formula: soil-quad bottom-left + 13% along the front edge, +22 px (back) / +30 px (front) down past the rim.
tag.drawOrder: depth-sort by row: back-row plants -> back-row tags -> front-row plants -> front-row tags (a back tag can be partly behind a tall front plant; lift the hovered/selected bed's tag to the top). Tag face content: up to 4 care icons at 0.75x (48 PNG px) along the top of faceBox, need dots at 16 PNG px under each; complete = bloom-stamp fitted to faceBox height; resting = resting-leaf fitted to faceBox.
tag.nightNote: night tint matches stake night (blend 42% toward #34405F). At dawn/midday use day.

card.nightNote: same 720x560 and identical layout boxes; 42% blend toward #34405F. On it draw ink #3E2A1A and use the DAY icon/dot/check/stamp files (the -night ones are too low-contrast on the dimmed card; keep -night for the in-scene tag).
card.rowOrder: sun, water, fertilizer, stake (omit the stake row for plants that are not staked; rows stay top-aligned)
card.note: All boxes in PNG px (x0,y0,x1,y1); halve for display. dots = centre points; draw dot PNGs at dotSize PNG px. status = optional soft check per row. stamp = where the bloom stamp sits when the card is complete (overlaps top-right corner).

soil.fullFrame: scene/soil/soil-{day|night}-all.png (1280x720, all 8 beds; alternative to the per-bed files)
soil.units: 1x backdrop px; drawImage(img, pos[0], pos[1]) in art space, no scaling
soil.order: draw after drawBackdrop() and before plants/selection ring; pre-shaped to each bed's soil quad (stone rims and lawn left clear), no masking needed
soil.lighting: day file for dawn/midday, night file for night; crossfade with the same lightWeights as the backdrop (day alpha = 1 - weights.night)
soil.fade: fade in over ~1.2 s when a tag completes; remove at the morning reset

passiveSun.added: 2026-11-18 care remap: sun fills by itself during the day (no player action)
passiveSun.levelsNote: drop-in replacement for icon-sun in the sun slot (same 64px / 32 display, centred). The ring has 3 arcs clockwise from 12 o'clock: 0 = faint dotted ring + pale sun (dawn, nothing yet), 1/2/3 = arcs lit with a growing warm halo; 3 = full ring = sun need met. Suggested mapping: level = ceil(3 * sunGiven / sunNeeded) so 1-, 2- and 3-dot plants all end on the full ring; or drive it from daylight progress. Crossfade between levels ~0.6 s.

resting.note: night: replaces the sun slot (sun is paused, not failed). Tag in the scene uses -night (30% tint so the cloud still reads); the needs card at night uses sun-resting.png (card rule: day files on the card). Whatever sun was earned today stays counted.

badge.cardPlacement: sun row (rows[0]) only: centre at (548, row.top+43) PNG px, i.e. x460-636, so it sits where the dots were and leaves the status box free. Not tappable, no hover. Text "by daylight" is baked in Lora (ink #5C4028 day / #3E2A1A on the night card); the -blank files let code draw its own text at x>=0.31*w.
badge.note: Card at night: per the card rule use badge-by-daylight.png (day) on needs-card-night, or the -night file if it looks too bright. The -night badge is mostly for any in-scene use.

passiveSun.cardRow: Sun row = icon box shows sun-glow-{level} (sun-resting at night), label "Sunlight", the by-daylight badge replaces the 1-3 dots; show need-done in the status box once level 3. Keep icon-sun + need dots files: if Sprout keeps sun dots on tags, fill them automatically and still show the badge on the card.
passiveSun.tag: On the wooden tag: put sun-glow-{level} (48 PNG px, i.e. 0.75x, same as other icons) in the sun column with no dots under it (the ring is the meter); at night use sun-resting-night. Columns: sun, water, fertilizer, [stake].

harvestPrompt.added: 2026-11-18: breathing harvests a fully grown plant

icon.note: basket of produce; use as the "click to harvest" prompt over or next to a fully grown plant / its tag

iconSmall.note: care-icon size, e.g. on the tag face or needs card in place of the care rows once fully grown

badge.anchor: bottom-centre of the badge sits ~8 display px above the top of the plant sprite (or centred over the tag face)
badge.note: cream disc + honey ring + basket. harvest-badge-glow.png is the warm ring alone: draw it under the badge and pulse opacity 0.35->1 on a 4 s in/out cycle in time with the breath guide (inhale brighten, exhale soften). Gentle bob 2 px. Show only when the plant is fully grown and harvestable; hide while the breath harvest is running.
